newsitem.title: USA: Enron closes Portland General merger.
newsitem.headline: Enron closes Portland General merger.

text.p: Enron Corp said Wednesday it completed its $3 billion merger with Portland General Corp on July 1 as scheduled.

The deal called for Enron to issue 50.5 million new common shares to Portland General shareholders, consolidate Portland General's $1.1 billion debt and account for the transaction on a purchase accounting basis.
The merger created a company with assets of about $19 billion, it said.
Enron is North America's largest wholesale marketer of natural gas and electricity, and Portland General is a low-cost electric utility based in Oregon.
